persos.pose: standing in the foreground in the middle, chest out, holding his passport proudly

persos.desc: grandmother in her 70s, coral-and-amber kaftan, headscarf, holding ONE single wooden walking stick
persos.pose: sitting on a plastic chair on the right, holding the stick, stern

dialogue: Tonton, c'est vrai tu es Français maintenant ?
Oui, mon petit. Plus personne me commande dêh !
Le Français-là, va acheter mon attiéké !
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The boy asks, eyes wide with admiration. The uncle lifts his passport proudly and declares it, his face three-quarters to the camera. The grandma taps her stick once on the ground and gives the last line as an order, her face clearly visible.
chute: The uncle's proud chest deflates instantly and he lowers the passport, obedient. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the proud uncle's defeated face looking into the camera.

mecanisme: fanfaronnade démolie sur-le-champ par l'autorité de la grand-mère

lieu: market stall in Abatta, Abidjan, a wooden table piled with tomatoes and onions, a big parasol, morning

persos.desc: woman in her 50s, lavender-and-charcoal kaba, big earrings, holding ONE single straw basket
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left in front of the stall, holding the basket, chin high

persos.desc: market seller in her 40s, peach-and-ruby wrap dress, headwrap, holding ONE single tomato
persos.pose: sitting behind the stall on the right, holding a tomato

dialogue: Mon fils est en Amérique dêh ! Il gagne en dollars !
Ya fohi, Tantie. Pour toi, la tomate est mille maintenant.
Ehh, il a perdu son travail ce matin.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The mother lifts her chin and brags loudly, her face three-quarters to the camera. The seller smiles slyly and raises the tomato, announcing the new price. The mother's proud face drops at once and she answers with a sad face, her face clearly visible.
chute: The seller raises one eyebrow, not believing a word. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the bragging mother's fake-sad face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE FILS EN AMÉRIQUE QUAND IL APPREND ÇA :
mecanisme: rétropédalage instantané : la vantardise se retourne contre elle au prix du marché (deux cibles : la vendeuse rapace et la mère)
